ideas.title: The red dot
ideas.critique: This is the moth again: the pointer becomes a thing on the island and the friends chase it. The stalk, wiggle and pounce poses and the pile-up add animation, not a new idea. The pounce animation is the only real step, and anyone who knows the island will expect the dogpile on Lumi.

ideas.title: Spin echo
ideas.critique: Real Bloch precession that refocuses into one shared heading at the same instant is new physics the island never had, and the snap back into order is a real payoff. The risk is that from above it reads as creatures turning on the spot unless the dephasing and the echo can be seen at a glance; it is also another crowd-under-a-rule film.

ideas.title: The cottage is a camera
ideas.critique: A true camera obscura is light transport that only a path tracer gets right, so it is a strong showcase of what the renderer can do, and seeing friends walk upside down on the wall is a picture people would share. It is still the island shown on a surface inside a prop, like the TV, and the live game only gets a dark window.

ideas.title: What nobody looks at
ideas.critique: Things that turn into rough blocks is the grey-draft patch again. What is new is that it follows the player's own gaze, which makes the camera a toy and gives a reason to spin round to catch things. Whether it surprises depends on how sharpening back feels in play, not on the blocks.

ideas.title: I molt
ideas.critique: Another close-up gag of Lumi's body turning see-through with a friend inside it, straight after the jelly ball; the shell left standing and the friend wearing it is the one fresh beat. A thin-film shell is good material work, but the recipe is the last post's.

ideas.title: Listen before talk
ideas.critique: Running real carrier-sense backoff on the speech system gives a new rule for how the friends talk, and the polite deadlock is funny to sit and watch in the live game. It is one more rule on speech, and with faces alone the timing of the comedy has to carry it, which is easy to get flat.

ideas.title: The house walks
ideas.critique: A building on legs that walks to a new spot is a scripted event with a prop of a kind the island has, and the morning search is an errand people will guess. The dusk shot over the pond could be a lovely picture, but nothing in it can be played or watched twice.

ideas.title: Low tide
ideas.critique: Moving the sea level is the seesaw and flood idea run in reverse, and a ring of placed props and a race back are a scripted event. The wet glossy floor with the sky in the puddles is the strong part, but it is material work hung on a predictable change to the whole island.

ideas.title: Something big walks by
ideas.critique: Giant ankles you never see whole is good restraint and could make the best night picture so far, and waves from each step tie it to the sea. Underneath it is a scripted night event where the friends hide, with nothing for the player and nothing new about how things move.

ideas.title: The island in a snow globe
ideas.critique: Shaking the world so the friends slide is the tilt game again in a new frame, and the human's goals already name sloshing water as an example. Seeing the island through real glass, with snow as a particle system you play with your hand, is the strong part and something people would come back to.
